report_name: Russian APT Star Blizzard Evolves Phishing with 'RedFlick' Technique

threat_actors.name: Star Blizzard
threat_actors.description: A Russian APT group, associated with FSB Centre 18, known for intelligence gathering. The group has evolved its phishing tactics from a multi-step 'ClickFix' method to a more efficient single-interaction technique called 'RedFlick' to deploy the CosmicPulse backdoor against Ukraine-linked targets.
threat_actors.goals: Intelligence gathering against organizations and individuals with expertise on Russia or those involved in international policy and Ukrainian aid efforts.

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing Link
attack_patterns.description: Star Blizzard uses spear-phishing emails containing a malicious link to initiate the 'RedFlick' infection chain, requiring only a single click from the victim.

attack_patterns.name: Scheduled Task
attack_patterns.description: As part of the 'RedFlick' technique, a series of scheduled tasks are created to establish persistence and achieve delayed execution of the CosmicPulse backdoor, evading immediate detection.

attack_patterns.name: Python
attack_patterns.description: The CosmicPulse backdoor is a Python-based payload, indicating the use of the Python interpreter for execution on the victim's machine for command and control.

malware.name: CosmicPulse
malware.description: A custom Python-based backdoor deployed by Star Blizzard. It establishes a command and control channel to exfiltrate data, execute commands, and deploy further tools.

tools.name: schtasks
tools.description: Used by Star Blizzard as part of the 'RedFlick' technique to create scheduled tasks for persistence and delayed payload execution.

identities.name: FSB Centre 18
identities.description: The Russian Federal Security Service (FSB) unit that Star Blizzard is associated with.

identities.name: Non-governmental organizations
identities.description: A class of organizations targeted by Star Blizzard's 'RedFlick' phishing campaigns for their involvement in supporting Ukraine.

identities.name: Think tanks
identities.description: A class of policy and research organizations targeted by Star Blizzard for their expertise on Russia and international policy related to Ukraine.

identities.name: Journalists
identities.description: A class of individuals targeted by Star Blizzard's phishing campaigns due to their work related to Ukraine.

infrastructure.name: CosmicPulse C2 Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Command and control infrastructure used by the CosmicPulse backdoor to communicate with Star Blizzard's operators.

indicators.name: Star Blizzard RedFlick Persistence via schtasks
indicators.pattern:
title: Star Blizzard RedFlick Persistence via schtasks
id: 7e5d9f1a-8c3b-4e2d-9f0a-1b2c3d4e5f6a
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a scheduled task using schtasks.exe, a technique used by Star Blizzard in their 'RedFlick' phishing campaigns to achieve persistence.
references:
  - https://www.darkreading.com/threat-intelligence/russia-star-blizzard-apt-ditches-clickfix-widen-phishing-net
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-01
tags:
  - attack.t1053.005
  - attack.persistence
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '/create'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of schtasks.exe to create a new scheduled task, a persistence method used in Star Blizzard's 'RedFlick' technique.
